column1: # 54% of Californians lived in families below the true cost of economic security in 2023, against 49% nationally.

# Source: Urban Institute, American Affordability Tracker and Measuring the True Cost of Economic Security (ODC-BY 1.0). The threshold is what a family needs to cover essentials and save for emergencies and the future, set higher than the poverty line. Districts range from 33% (District 36) to 73% (District 37).
